<p>"I'm Jeon Sang-hoon. My position is Tank."</p><p>"I'm Kang Jun-seo. My position is Combat Support."</p><p>"I'm Ju Ye-jun. I'm also a Tank."</p><p>"I'm Yu Si-woo. Porter... Well, nice to meet you."</p><p>"I'm Yang Ha-yoon. My position is Team Leader and Attacker."</p><p>"...Yes, I'm Yoon Seong-hyeon. This time, I'll be joining as a supervisor."</p><p>After everyone finished their introductions, Im Ye-won spoke.</p><p>"Hunter Yoon Seong-hyeon will only be accompanying us as a supervisor, so he won't intervene unless it's an emergency."</p><p>'Hmm... The position balance isn't bad.'</p><p>Especially Yang Ha-yoon, the team leader and the only D-rank Hunter on the team—she was a pure offensive Awakened with the highest growth potential.</p><p>From the way she constantly briefed each team member on their roles during the move, her preparedness was thorough.</p><p>The rest seemed ordinary... but seeing Yu Si-woo, the porter, made my feelings a little complicated.</p><p>Calling him a "porter" was just a nice way of saying he was a pack mule. When one Awakens, they develop an outstanding specialty. The rarest is healing, followed by combat enhancement support, tanking, attacking, etc... Since gates are typically entered by multiple people, it's important to assign team members who can compensate for each other's weaknesses.</p><p>But what if you Awaken and still have no outstanding abilities? That's me. This is where roles diverge. Hunters like me are called "hexagonal Hunters."</p><p>We aren't exceptionally skilled in one area, but our stats are evenly distributed, allowing us to handle any situation appropriately.</p><p>If you're lucky like me and have a large hexagon, you're called versatile... but for hexagonal Hunters with small stats, they're nothing more than pack mules.</p><p>In other words, Yu Si-woo was an "Unlucky Yu Seong-hyeon."</p><p>"We've arrived. Please be careful on your way."</p><p>"Shall we go?"</p><p>Yang Ha-yoon entered the gate with confidence.</p><p>'I hope this ends quickly.'</p><p>***</p><p>"···."</p><p>Everyone had entered the gate, but the atmosphere was uneasy.</p><p>Gates vary wildly from one to another. Some resemble untouched nature, others a cave interior, or even a medieval castle.</p><p>But the scene before us was that of an urban cityscape.</p><p>'The vibe is like Hong Kong.'</p><p>The reason for the uneasy atmosphere was clear.</p><p>There was a well-known rule among Hunters.</p><p>The more a Gate’s landscape resembles a futuristic or modern city, the more difficult it is.</p><p>It wasn’t unheard of for a D-rank Gate to contain a city, but it wasn’t common either. The problem was that the report had clearly stated it was a vast grassland, yet here we were, staring at a city.</p><p>"Uh…"</p><p>Yang Ha-yoon turned around to look at me.</p><p><img src="data:image/webp;base64," alt="290633" loading="lazy">
</p><p>"What do we do now…?"</p><p>All five of them were staring at me.</p><p>"Hmm… It’s not unheard of for a Gate’s contents to change overnight. The background shifting doesn’t necessarily mean the rank becomes more dangerous, but… in this case, it might be a D-rank dungeon bordering on C-rank."</p><p>"…"</p><p>Silence fell again. Everyone was waiting for my orders.</p><p>Gates fundamentally worked like this: once the boss of the Gate was defeated, an exit portal would open, and the Gate would fully close a week later. So, a Hunter’s job was to take down the boss. After the Hunters finished their work, the recovery team would enter and scour the Gate for useful resources over the next week.</p><p>However, even if the boss wasn’t defeated, the portal that appeared when entering the Gate wouldn’t disappear. That meant if things went south, we could just turn around and leave the same way we came.</p><p>"If I joined in, there wouldn’t be a problem, but since I’m a supervisor… I think it’d be best for us to turn back this time."</p><p>"No way."</p><p>Seo Sang-hoon frowned in disapproval.</p><p>‘Fuck… I knew this would happen.’</p><p>The reason they’d sent me as a supervisor was because these Hunters were undergoing promotion evaluations.</p><p>E-rank Hunters were underpaid for the life-or-death work they did.</p><p>Successfully exploring this Gate and promoting to D-rank was extremely important to them. If we turned back less than an hour after entering, regardless of the reason, their chances of promotion this time would be slim to none.</p><p>"Well, everyone has their own circumstances, but…"</p><p>"I don’t want to go back either."</p><p>"If we fail this time, we’ll have to wait another whole year."</p><p>Joo Ye-jun and Kang Jun-seo also voiced their opposition.</p><p>‘Ugh, should I just beat them all up and drag them out?’</p><p>The contract stated that if Hunters refused to follow a supervisor’s orders, the supervisor was legally permitted to use physical force.</p><p>Taking down three E-ranks bare-handed by smashing their heads in wasn’t even a challenge.</p><p>"Hmm…"</p><p>As if she’d read my mind, Yang Ha-yoon urgently stepped in front of me, blocking my path.</p><p>"Supervisor, how about we explore a little more first… and if it really gets dangerous, we can turn back then? If you truly think it’s too risky, we’ll all retreat without argument. Everyone else agrees, right?"</p><p>Everyone nodded, accepting the compromise.</p><p>"Sigh… Fine. If I say we retreat, then we retreat."</p><p>"Yes! Thank you, Supervisor!"</p><p>***</p><p>KWADDUK—</p><p>A monstrous white bird, its wingspan easily exceeding 20 meters with eight black eyes, was viciously slamming into a shield as if trying to smash through it.</p><p>It didn’t look like any Earth-born creature.</p><p>"Hang in there, Sang-hoon! There’ll be an opening soon!"</p><p>Behind the tankers holding their shields, Yang Ha-yoon kept a sharp eye out for the monster’s weak point.</p><p>"Gh—! Got it!"</p><p>She assessed her teammates’ strengths, issued commands, and never neglected her own role—all while keeping the monster in her sights.</p><p>"Now—!"</p><p>Yang Ha-yoon dashed through the gap between the shields, then leapt into the air and slashed at the monster’s head. The beast belatedly tried to change course, but her sword was faster. After landing safely, she didn’t let her guard down, instead hacking at the fallen head on the ground.</p><p>"Whoa… She’s good."</p><p>'At this point, you could call her a one-woman team.'</p><p>There were a few close calls, but she overcame each one with her own skill. And more than anything, she felt familiar. Her fighting style, her very presence—it all seemed like something I’d seen before.</p><p>"The boss should be coming out soon. Since it’s getting late, let’s camp here for the night and finish the exploration tomorrow morning."</p><p>"Understood."</p><p>***</p><p>After eating the dinner Yu Si-woo had prepared and setting up our overnight camp, we decided to take watch in pairs. Yang Ha-yoon and I took the first shift.</p><p>No one complained about the order.</p><p>And for good reason—it was common sense that the strongest members should be at their best, so Yang Ha-yoon and I were assigned the earliest shift.</p><p>"Can... can I ask you something?"</p><p>"Yes."</p><p>Yang Ha-yoon cautiously met my gaze as she spoke.</p><p>"Pardon me, but how old are you, Supervisor?"</p><p>"Twenty-two."</p><p>"What?! Haha... You're younger than me. I'm twenty-five."</p><p>"Yes..."</p><p>"You must be incredibly talented. To be a B-rank at such a young age..."</p><p>"You’ll probably rank up soon too, Ha-yoon."</p><p>"Really?"</p><p>Even with such trivial small talk, Yang Ha-yoon laughed as if she were genuinely enjoying herself.</p><p>'Ah... why does she feel so familiar? Who is she?'</p><p>"Can I ask you for a favor?"</p><p>"I’ll listen first, then decide."</p><p>"After our night watch ends, could you spar with me?"</p><p>"Huh? Without resting?"</p><p>"What’s the point of resting? I’m not even tired."</p><p>"Ah!"</p><p>It hit me.</p><p>   <img src="data:image/webp;base64," alt="290634" loading="lazy">
</p><p>Hey! Yoon Seong-hyeon, you’re graduating next year, so why are you always slacking off?! Resting won’t do you any good—go pick up that sword over there and practice!</p><p>Hye-na. Kang Hye-na.</p><p>I’d been feeling a strange familiarity this whole time—her swordplay and even her tone were identical to Kang Hye-na’s.</p><p>'I just talked to her on the phone a few days ago, and I’m only realizing it now.'</p><p>After graduating from Hunter Training Academy, we’d only exchanged the occasional work calls over the past three years, so her face hadn’t come to mind.</p><p>Of course, only the vibe was similar—her abilities were nothing alike.</p><p>'Well, Kang Hye-na *is* a state-recognized monster practically guaranteed to promote to S-rank.'</p><p>"Why... are you looking at me like that?"</p><p>"Ah, no, it’s nothing. Fine, let’s do it. Though I’m not very good with long swords, so I’m not sure how much help I’ll be."</p><p>"You’ll still be better than me."</p><p>***</p><p>"KRAAAAAA!!!"</p><p>CRACK—!</p><p>A massive white-furred ape swung its arm, and a concrete pillar shattered in an instant.</p><p>'A monkey as the boss in an urban setting? I get it, but I don’t get it.'</p><p>The tanks held up their shields, blocking the boss’s attacks while drawing its attention, and Gang Jun-seo carefully stabbed the enemy with his spear whenever he saw an opening, then quickly retreated.</p><p>Swish—!</p><p>"GRAAAH!!!"</p><p>'Almost there.'</p><p>The boss had been sliced apart by Yang Ha-yoon, its hide torn in places, bleeding, and now it seemed exhausted, its breath ragged.</p><p>BOOM—!!!</p><p>The boss launched its final attack, but Yang Ha-yoon nimbly dodged, then lunged into its embrace and plunged the final dagger into its heart.</p><p>"Kuh…·"</p><p>Vvvvvv—</p><p>As the boss collapsed into silence, the escape portal opened.</p><p>"Phew… it’s over. Everyone did great."</p><p>"Let’s head back."</p><p>After passing through the portal, Im Ye-won was standing there.</p><p>"Good work. Is the gate exploration finished?"</p><p>"Yes, you can call the recovery team now. Can we go back then?"</p><p>"I’ve prepared a car to take Hunter Yoon Seong-hyeon home. The payment will be processed first thing tomorrow."</p><p>'Jackpot.'</p><p>"Thank you. Then I’ll be going."</p><p>I head home. My dead heart starts pounding again, thumping wildly.</p><p>"Uh… Director! Or, Seong-hyeon-ssi!"</p><p>"Yes?"</p><p>"If it’s not too much trouble… could I have your number?"</p><p>"…Sure."</p><p>Honestly, I didn’t want to give it, but I didn’t want to drag this out, so I handed over my number.</p><p>She’s probably thinking I have connections in the Association and plans to ask for help later when she needs it.</p><p>'Man, I gotta get home fast.'</p><p>"Then I’ll contact you…!"</p><p>"Yeah, yeah, go on in."</p><p>"Driver, let’s leave right away."</p><p>Just imagining the special service Mom has planned for tonight makes my crotch swell so much my pants feel like they’ll burst.</p><p>Have I really become a body that can’t live without Mom?</p>
